'''Trinity Deploy''' is the full release of an Omniagent version from a single
operator message, ''"Trinity Deploy of Omniagent in version X.Y.Z"''. The handler
does '''not''' run the pipeline itself: it creates '''three chained omnidev kanban
tasks''' that run in order, then reports the task ids.

== The three tasks ==

{| class="wikitable"
|-
! # !! Task title pattern !! Purpose
|-
| A || Run deploy.py dev successfully (release cycle vX.Y.Z prerequisite) || Dev-mode deploy to green in the omnidev dev environment.
|-
| B || deploy.py hybrid: commit and push omni repos, tag omni-deployer vX.Y.Z and push to trigger CI || The release: hybrid run, commit and push, tag, CI trigger.
|-
| C || Post-hybrid vX.Y.Z: wait for CI, back up production, validate on omnistable, then stop the three stacks || Release validation on the omnistable deployment.
|}

Dependencies are recorded with <code>kanban_add-kanban-dependency</code>:
'''B depends on A''', '''C depends on B'''.

{{OmniFact
|what=three chained release tasks (dev, hybrid, post-hybrid)
|where=the omnidev kanban board
|status=in use
|source=Projects/Omniagent/Trinity-Deploy.md
}}

== Task A - deploy dev ==

# Run <code>deploy.py dev</code> end-to-end against the omnidev dev environment.
# All deploy stages complete, the dev stack healthy, integration tests pass.
# Commit and push only if a repo needs a deploy, seed or test-only change. Do NOT
# bump versions or tag anything.

== Task B - hybrid and tag ==

# Run <code>deploy.py hybrid</code> to successful completion.
# On success, commit and push the changed omni repos to main and verify local
# equals origin/main for each.
# Tag omni-deployer with <code>vX.Y.Z</code> and push the tag, which triggers CI.

The version bumps must be pushed '''before''' the hybrid run, because hybrid
Step 0.4 has a CI-consistency preflight that fails fast on a dirty or unpushed
repo. The tag is pushed '''after''' the run succeeds. The deploy script itself
never runs <code>git commit</code>, <code>git tag</code> or <code>git push</code>.

== Task C - post-hybrid ==

# Wait for the CI run triggered by the tag to finish; fix and re-release until green.
# As soon as CI is green, force-run the PRODUCTION cron task <code>daily-backup</code>
# with <code>{"force": true}</code>.
# Bring omnistable up at the '''current production version''', then restore the
# database from that up-to-date backup.
# Upgrade omnistable to the release version and verify it answers end to end.
# Stop the <code>omnidev</code>, <code>omnideploy</code> and <code>omnistable</code>
# stacks after the last step.

A cron or backup failure is '''not''' a blocker: the restore and every remaining
step still run, using the newest available backup, and the failure is reported.
The production <code>omni-stack</code> project is '''never''' stopped.

== Run pattern and safety ==

* Develop and deploy ONLY in the omnidev, dev and omnistable environments.
* Run the python process directly inside the always-available production
  omniagent container, never in a container the deploy itself tears down.
* The production image already ships docker CLI and compose plugin, python3,
  git and node/npm, and mounts the docker socket.
* Never run <code>up</code>, <code>down</code>, <code>restart</code>,
  <code>stop</code> or <code>recreate</code> against the <code>omni-stack</code>
  project; production changes only through the release pipeline.
